# Test matrix (generated by running the real workflow)

Dataset: synthetic, seed 42. Expected values are hand-written from the policy in `scripts/make_test_matrix.py`.

| Scenario                                             | Input                                          | Expected                                           | Actual                                             | Result   |
|:-----------------------------------------------------|:-----------------------------------------------|:---------------------------------------------------|:---------------------------------------------------|:---------|
| CLEAN (Clean 3-way match)                            | all lines match PO & GRN, bank/GST ok, < limit | APPROVE / AUTO_APPROVED_SIMULATED / 1 attempt(s)   | APPROVE / AUTO_APPROVED_SIMULATED / 1 attempt(s)   | PASS     |
| PRICE_TOL (Price +1% (within tolerance))             | unit price +1% (tolerance 2%)                  | APPROVE / AUTO_APPROVED_SIMULATED / 1 attempt(s)   | APPROVE / AUTO_APPROVED_SIMULATED / 1 attempt(s)   | PASS     |
| PRICE_OVER (Price above tolerance)                   | unit price +8..15%                             | HOLD / PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW / 1 attempt(s)         | HOLD / PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW / 1 attempt(s)         | PASS     |
| QTY_OVER (Billed more than received)                 | billed qty > received qty                      | PAY_PARTIAL / PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW / 1 attempt(s)  | PAY_PARTIAL / PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW / 1 attempt(s)  | PASS     |
| NO_GRN (No goods receipt yet)                        | PO exists, no goods receipt                    | HOLD / PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW / 1 attempt(s)         | HOLD / PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW / 1 attempt(s)         | PASS     |
| DUPLICATE (Duplicate invoice (re-formatted number))  | same vendor+number, different format           | REJECT / PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW / 1 attempt(s)       | REJECT / PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW / 1 attempt(s)       | PASS     |
| BANK_CHANGE (Bank account changed)                   | bank account differs from vendor master        | ESCALATE / PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW / 1 attempt(s)     | ESCALATE / PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW / 1 attempt(s)     | PASS     |
| TAX_MISMATCH (Wrong GST rate)                        | GST rate wrong for vendor                      | HOLD / PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW / 1 attempt(s)         | HOLD / PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW / 1 attempt(s)         | PASS     |
| NO_PO (No purchase order)                            | no PO reference                                | HOLD / PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW / 1 attempt(s)         | HOLD / PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW / 1 attempt(s)         | PASS     |
| HIGH_VALUE (Clean but above approval limit)          | clean but payable > INR 5,00,000               | ESCALATE / PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW / 1 attempt(s)     | ESCALATE / PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW / 1 attempt(s)     | PASS     |
| ARITH_ERROR (Declared total is wrong)                | declared total 5% off                          | HOLD / PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW / 1 attempt(s)         | HOLD / PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW / 1 attempt(s)         | PASS     |
| MULTI_BANK_QTY (Bank change AND over-billing)        | bank change + over-billing                     | ESCALATE / PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW / 1 attempt(s)     | ESCALATE / PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW / 1 attempt(s)     | PASS     |
| MULTI_DUP_PRICE (Duplicate AND price over tolerance) | duplicate + price over                         | REJECT / PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW / 1 attempt(s)       | REJECT / PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW / 1 attempt(s)       | PASS     |
| Missing invoice number + qty 0                       | invoice_no='' and qty=0                        | HOLD / PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW / 1 attempt(s)         | HOLD / PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW / 1 attempt(s)         | PASS     |
| Bad date                                             | invoice_date='31/13/2026'                      | HOLD / PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW / 1 attempt(s)         | HOLD / PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW / 1 attempt(s)         | PASS     |
| PO reference not in system                           | po_id='PO-9999'                                | HOLD / PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW / 1 attempt(s)         | HOLD / PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW / 1 attempt(s)         | PASS     |
| Fault: transient wrong payable                       | QTY_OVER + inflate_payable on attempt 1        | PAY_PARTIAL / PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW / 2 attempt(s)  | PAY_PARTIAL / PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW / 2 attempt(s)  | PASS     |
| Fault: transient on clean invoice                    | CLEAN + inflate_payable on attempt 1           | APPROVE / AUTO_APPROVED_SIMULATED / 2 attempt(s)   | APPROVE / AUTO_APPROVED_SIMULATED / 2 attempt(s)   | PASS     |
| Fault: persistent wrong approval                     | DUPLICATE + force_approve on both attempts     | ESCALATE / ESCALATED_CRITIC_FAILURE / 2 attempt(s) | ESCALATE / ESCALATED_CRITIC_FAILURE / 2 attempt(s) | PASS     |

**19/19 passed.**
